flow.description: Oct2/Oct3 native fullscreen reference: 33 finite frames and48 configured controls. All/None → Class/detail/Notice → Exam → Payment draft/result, date/month cycles and separate Oct2/Oct3 Home DEMO callers. Payment Month → Events → Week5 → Month plus Show/Hide History and observed reset. First DEMO history card now opens loaded-image record detail, amount show/hide, Back and Student Account Portal loading → titled blank → More/Cancel/X → detail → history. Actual Present paths replayed; initial missing photo and repeated missing loading mark retained, reuploaded via image fills and sampled again. All financial titles/identifiers/dates/amounts and Week class content are synthetic DEMO. Generic illustration and logo raster, fonts/icons/geometry approximate; initial pre-image layout, image expansion, shown-detail exits, other records/menus/scroll and external/share/copy/refresh remain unimplemented. Portal blank does not establish service/login success or server failure. Notice/Portal800ms are illustrative delays. Native coordinate input was noWindowsAvailable; AX observations separate from tool failures. Other date/mode/caller combinations and complete app/fidelity remain unverified. Actual saved pixels determine rendered state despite lagging URL readback.
